Date: 26.4.29.

Subject (in full) Arrival of Soviet agent.

Made by F. J. S. Makaroff Forwarded by Thos Rubenstein

Information has been received to the effect
that Mr. F.J.S. Makaroff, who recently arrived from Harbin, is a
Soviet agent and an employee of the Chinese Eastern Railway.
Formerly considered to be a White Russian he was in charge of
the Harbin Branch of Red Cross Society from 1921 to 1923, and
after its liquidation is reported to have sold to the Soviet
Consulate in Harbin all information and application forms of
the Officers of the White Army regarding length of service,
regiment, rank, etc. After that he obtained Soviet papers
and was employed by the C.E.R. as supervisor of summer resorts.
Mr. Makaroff resides at 15 Tsongchow Road.

N. Makaroff=
F. C. S.

I. O. D. 编号……
日期：1929年4月26日。

主题（全称）苏联特工抵沪。

制作人：F. J. S. Makaroff 转呈人：Thos Rubenstein

接获情报称，近期从哈尔滨抵达的 F.J.S. Makaroff 先生系一名苏联特工，且为中东铁路雇员。他此前被视为白俄分子，于1921年至1923年间负责红十字会哈尔滨分会的工作；据报在该分会解散后，他将白军军官关于服役年限、所属团部、军衔等所有信息及申请表出售给了苏联驻哈尔滨领事馆。此后，他取得了苏联证件，并被中东铁路雇用为避暑地主管。Makaroff 先生居住于通州路15号。

N. Makaroff=
F. C. S.

助理副督察长

HR.
4月26日
94:4:29

副本送：英国驻华总领事、Halland 上校、Shelley 上尉、Carlson 中尉

发送于4月29日。
C. Y. Ivy
